rimewalker.name: Rimewalker
rimewalker.desc: A steading hand the frost took walking. It still keeps to the paths it knew.

netmender.name: The Netmender
netmender.desc: Gunna of Saltfell, wrapped in the frozen net she would not stop mending, and in what the net brought home.

attacks._tell: right hand draws back to the ear, fingers together (0.6 s); three quick stabs, the third a beat late. Parryable. Phase 2 adds a fourth.
turns half away, gathers the net train into her left arm, frost-breath held (1.1 s); the net flies in an 8 m fan. Caught: snared 1.5 s (mash to break), then hauled in to a stitch. Roll sideways.
the Bearer is behind her for more than 1.5 s: she hunches and turns, Brede's mask swings into view (0.8 s); a 360 sweep of the net train, low, that knocks down.
kneels, both hands to the floor; the floor-net glows faint blue along a line toward the Bearer (1.4 s); a line of ice-knots erupts and leaves a ridge for 10 s that blocks movement.
leans back, arms crossed over her chest, a creak of rope through the room (1.0 s); the floor-net drags everything 3 m toward her, then a stitch. Sprint away to hold position.
rises to full height, the net train lifted over her head like a sail, Brede's figure visible (1.6 s); the whole net comes down in front of her, 10 x 4 m. Then a 2 s punish window.
kneels at a ridge she made (0.8 s); every ridge is frozen anew and stands longer. Two heavy hits break a ridge.
right hand to the ear (0.7 s); two stabs.
as the Cast, but she does not turn away: the net comes from over her shoulder (1.3 s); a wider fan, 10 m.
crouches over, curls around Brede (2.0 s). No attack; the breath slows. She is open: this is the moment. Left alone 6 s, she stands and resumes.

netmender._fight: SLICE.md 6. Phases by HP fraction (phase_at): 1 above 0.6, 2 to 0.25, 3 below. Each attack lists the phases it belongs to; by_phase overrides a field per phase. phase_speed scales every timing (phase 3 is slower). Telegraphs: body (anim + breath) and, for moves that cover ground, a floor glow over the exact area (telegraph). Intro: she mends until the Bearer is within wake_dist or strikes her.

wake._tell: stops mending, ties off the knot, bites the twine (a sound), stands; the bar appears

p2._tell: grabs the floor-net with both hands and pulls: the floor slides 2 m toward her, the tables and benches at the walls slam over

p3._tell: she stops and puts her hand through the net at her back to hold his; from now on the left hand stays behind her

oarsman.name: Oarsman
oarsman.desc: A rower frozen mid-stroke. The oar has grown into his hands.

attacks._tell: oar drawn back past the right side, torso coils (0.8 s); a wide sweep across the front, 3 m reach. Roll through toward him.
pauses at the end of the Stroke, feet shuffle (0.5 s); the sweep comes back the other way. Only after a Stroke.
oar raised vertical and held, frost-breath rises straight up (1.2 s); the blade slams down and an ice shockwave runs 4 m forward. Then 1.4 s dragging the oar back up: the riposte window.

oar._doc: the procedural ice oar (src/enemies/oarsman.gd): metres along the shaft

hearthhound.name: Hearthhound
hearthhound.desc: A household dog that froze waiting at a door. It will not leave the threshold.

attacks._tell: crouches, ears flatten, frost-breath snort (0.5 s); a fast forward lunge, 2.5 m.
sits up, chest swells (0.7 s); a bark that alerts all frost-taken within 15 m. No damage.

hearthhound._ai: threshold guard (src/enemies/hearthhound.gd): lies across its threshold; on sight it sits up and barks once (alerting all frost-taken within radius), then fights within leash metres of home, and walks back to lie down when pulled further. A lunge that lands from behind becomes a grab: it holds and shakes, mash to break.

grab._doc: a lunge that hits the Bearer from behind (angle between his facing and the hound, deg) holds him

barrow_sleeper.name: Barrow-sleeper
barrow_sleeper.desc: One of the turf-wrapped dead, sat up in the barrow mouth facing the road. Slow, and it hits like a falling door.

attacks._tell: right fist drawn up past the ear, turf flakes shake off the shoulder (0.9 s); one heavy overhand. Parryable. May follow with a Back-fist.
weight shifts to the left foot (0.55 s); a left backhand. Only after a Hammer-fist.
both arms rise, it leans back, frost-breath twice (1.3 s); it falls forward full length like a turf door coming down over a 1.8 x 3.4 m strip. Not blockable. Then 2 s lying there and getting up.

barrow_sleeper._ai: LOWE.md 5. Sits up in a barrow mouth facing the road (pose sit_up) and rises slowly when the Bearer comes into sight.

keener.name: Keener
keener.desc: A masked mourner who lost the words and only breathes the tune.

attacks._tell: head tips back, the mask lifts, a thin held breath (0.9 s); one slow note of frost.
both hands to the mask, it rocks forward twice, a long held breath (1.5 s); three notes in a fan.
turns its face away, shoulders rise (0.7 s); a 2.8 m ring glows; it breathes out on whoever is close. Knocks back.
straightens, hands drop, breath straight up (0.8 s); every idle frost-taken within 16 m turns to the Bearer and comes. No damage.

keener._ai: LOWE.md 5. Keeps its distance (keep_range) and breathes the tune at the Bearer; breathes out on anyone who closes in; now and then rouses the idle dead nearby.

cairn_carrier.name: Cairn-carrier
cairn_carrier.desc: Frozen stones have grown across its shoulders. It carries them up the hill and does not know why.

attacks._tell: twists the whole torso away, the stones grind (1.0 s); the yoke swings round, a 220 degree sweep at 2.4 m. Roll away, not through.

stoops, both hands to the yoke, lifts one stone over its head (1.6 s); a 1.6 m square glows ahead; the stone comes down and stays as a cairn for 14 s. Not blockable. Two heavy blows knock the cairn down.
one stone lifted to the shoulder (1.3 s); a slow heavy lob at a Bearer more than 6 m off.

cairn_carrier._ai: LOWE.md 5. Carries its stones uphill; sets one down as a cairn in the Bearer's way; lobs one when kept at a distance.

turfwright.name: The Turfwright
turfwright.desc: Arne Holm, who cut and laid barrow-turf for every neighbourhood on the coast. He stopped with the last turf on his spade.

attacks._tell: spade-arm drawn up across his body, left fist braced (0.8 s); one heavy downward chop. Parryable on the blade.

plants his feet, sets the blade to the ground and leans on it, breath forward (1.3 s); a 1 x 12 m strip glows toward the Bearer. The cut runs along the ground and the lifted sod stands as a low wall for 8 s. Phase 1: a Cross cut half the time; phase 2: always; phase 3: slower, never.
pulls the blade free and re-aims, one step (0.9 s); a second cut at the Bearer's new place. Only after a Ground cut.
the Bearer is behind him for over 1.2 s: he straightens, the door on his back creaks (0.9 s); a 4 x 4.5 m patch behind him glows; he drops his back like a lid onto it. Not blockable.
lifts a block of turf, both arms, over his chest (1.4 s); a 1.4 x 3 m patch glows where the Bearer stands; he lays it there and it stays as a wall for 12 s. Not blockable.
one sod lifted to the shoulder (1.0 s); a slow heavy lob at a Bearer more than 6 m off.
spade dragged back along the ground (0.9 s); a wide 130 degree sweep.
spade drawn up, the sod held tight (0.9 s); one chop, slower.

the Bearer more than 6 m off: he turns to the door, kneels and lifts the sod to the doorway with both hands (2.0 s). No attack. He holds it there, his back to the Bearer: open. Hits do not stop him. Left alone 5 s, he lowers it to his chest and stands.

turfwright._fight: LOWE.md 6. Phases by HP fraction (phase_at): 1 above 0.6, 2 to 0.25, 3 below. Each attack lists its phases; by_phase overrides a field per phase; phase_speed scales every timing. Intro: he holds the last sod up to the twins' door until the Bearer is within wake_dist or strikes him. door_ahead: metres from where he stands to the doorway, along the way he first faces. guard_r: in phase 3 he keeps this close to the door. arena_walls: the phase-two sod walls, metres from where he first stood (x his right as he turns to the Bearer, z toward the way in).

wake._tell: lowers the spade, sets the sod down on the threshold stone, square, with both hands, and turns round; the bar appears

p2._tell: drives the spade into the ground and pulls: four walls of stacked sod rise in a cross and cut the hollow into bays

p3._tell: stops; stoops for the sod on the threshold and holds it to his chest in his left arm; the bay walls slump

ice_fisher.name: Ice-fisher
ice_fisher.desc: A fisher the frost took kneeling at a hole. Both hands have grown into ice-picks.
ice_fisher._ai: KETTLE.md 5. Kneels at a hole that is not there (pose kneel_fish) and rises when the Bearer comes into sight; jabs, and cuts a hole in the ice under him.

attacks._tell: right pick drawn back to the shoulder (0.5 s); a quick jab. Parryable. Often a second with the left.
weight forward, the left shoulder drops (0.4 s). Only after a Pick.
drops to one knee, both picks raised over the head (1.4 s); a 2 m circle glows where the Bearer stands; the ice there breaks to black water for 6 s. Off it in a second or go under.

sealer.name: Sealer
sealer.desc: A sealer the frost took waiting at a breathing hole. The right arm has fused into a club, the left hand into a hook.
sealer._ai: KETTLE.md 5. Clubs, and hooks the Bearer in from range to club him.

attacks._tell: club raised high behind the head, frost-breath puffs (1.0 s); one heavy overhand. Not parryable.
feet shuffle round (0.5 s); a backhand with the club. Only after a Club.
left arm thrown back low, hook turned out, breath held (1.0 s); a 1.2 x 5 m strip glows; the hook catches and drags the Bearer in to 1.5 m (mash to break), then a Club. Roll sideways.

sledge_dog.name: Sledge-dog
sledge_dog.desc: A sledge-dog frozen in harness. They come in pairs.
sledge_dog._ai: KETTLE.md 5. Pairs work from opposite sides (flank). A short snap, and the run down: flat out along a line and through.

attacks._tell: crouches, ears back, a snort (0.45 s); a short lunge bite, 2.5 m.
drops low, the traces tighten behind it (0.7 s); a 1.2 x 9 m strip glows; it runs flat out along the strip and through whoever is on it. Knocks down.

ice_cutter.name: The Ice-Cutter
ice_cutter.desc: Old Pell, who cut the fishing holes every winter and ran the sledge-dogs. He has kept one hole open.
ice_cutter._fight: KETTLE.md 6. Phases by HP fraction (phase_at). Each attack lists its phases; by_phase overrides a field per phase; phase_speed scales every timing. Intro: he kneels drilling at the rim until the Bearer is within wake_dist or strikes him. hole_ahead: metres from where he kneels to the hole's centre, along the way he first faces. guard_r: in phase 3 he keeps this close to the hole. ring_band: the phase-two band of broken ice round the arena (metres from the hole).

wake._tell: pulls the auger out of the ice, knocks the shavings off it against his boot, stands; the bar appears

p2._tell: stands over the hole and cuts a ring round the whole arena with one turn of the auger: the band between 9 and 10.5 m breaks open for the phase

p3._tell: the band closes over white; he goes back to the hole and kneels at it

attacks._tell: auger arm drawn back, the bit turning (0.8 s); a long downward thrust, 3.4 m. Parryable on the bit.

sets the auger point to the ice and leans on it, breath forward (1.4 s); a 2.4 m circle glows under the Bearer; the ice there breaks to black water for 7 s. Phase 2: a second hole where the Bearer is running to.

the left hand gathers the traces at his waist and flings them (1.2 s); a 1.4 x 10 m strip glows; the trace catches and drags the Bearer to the hole's rim, not to him (mash to break). Then an Auger thrust.
turns once on the spot, the auger tip trailing on the ice (1.3 s); a ring from 2.5 to 5 m round him glows and drops away for 6 s. Stand close or stand far.
whistles through the mask and looks back over his shoulder (1.6 s); a 2.4 x 18 m strip glows past the Bearer; the dead dog team runs down it and is gone. Knocks down.
the Bearer more than 5 m off: he turns to the hole, kneels and sets the auger to the rim (2.0 s). No attack. He drills, his back to the Bearer: open. Hits do not stop him. Left alone 5 s, he stands.

feast_guest.name: Feast-guest
feast_guest.desc: A guest the frost took in its seat at the feast. Both hands have grown into rounded fists of ice.
feast_guest._ai: TARNHALL.md 5. Sits on benches and barrels (pose sit / sit_feast) and stands when the Bearer passes close; cuffs, and brings both fists down round itself (The toast). The Host raises more of them from the benches.

attacks._tell: right fist swung round flat, shoulder first (0.6 s). Parryable. Often the left after it.
the weight goes over, the left fist low (0.45 s). Only after a Cuff.
both fists lifted together over the head as if raising a horn, breath twice (1.2 s); a 2.2 m circle glows round it; both fists come down on the floor and everything in the circle is hit. Step out.

cupbearer.name: Cupbearer
cupbearer.desc: A server the frost took between the benches. Both hands have grown into thin straight blades of ice.
cupbearer._ai: TARNHALL.md 5. Quick; comes in pairs and works from both sides (flank). Two cuts, a running lunge along a strip, and three turns on the spot with the blades out.

attacks._tell: blades crossed at the chest, a step in (0.35 s); two quick cuts. Parryable.
the right shoulder drops, the left blade goes back (0.6 s); a 1.0 x 5 m strip glows; it runs the strip blade first.
turns side-on, both blades out low like a tray (0.8 s); a 2.4 m circle glows; three turns on the spot, a cut each turn.

hall_champion.name: Hall-champion
hall_champion.desc: A hall guard the frost took at the door. A round board shield of ice has grown into the left forearm, and the right fist is a mace-head.
hall_champion._ai: TARNHALL.md 5. Circles with the shield up (block_arc, block_chance): strike it from the side or after it swings. A heavy mace, a shield bash, and a rush behind the shield along a strip.

attacks._tell: the ice fist raised behind the shield rim (0.9 s); one heavy overhand.
shield squared, a short step (0.5 s); little damage, a lot of poise. Often a Mace after it.
sets the shield and puts its head down behind it, breath held (1.0 s); a 1.6 x 7 m strip glows; it runs the strip behind the shield and knocks down what is on it. Cannot be blocked. Roll sideways.

host.name: The Host
host.desc: Gaute Haug, keeper of Tarnhall and host of the feast. He barred the doors when the guests began coughing, and kept filling their cups.
host._fight: TARNHALL.md 6. Phases by HP fraction (phase_at). Each attack lists its phases; by_phase overrides a field per phase; phase_speed scales every timing. Intro: he walks the table filling horns until the Bearer is within wake_dist or strikes him. The guests he raises are the seated feast-guest stills in the hall (seat_step: metres out from the bench; horn_ahead/horn_h: where the horn in front of a place is). guard_r: in phase 3 he keeps this close to where he stood.

wake._tell: sets the horn down on the table in front of a guest and turns round; the bar appears

p2._tell: spreads both arms over the table: two of the white guests stand up out of their places, and every horn in front of an empty place fills again

p3._tell: his frost on the floor goes grey; he walks back to the table and keeps to it

release_drop.label: Take the Host's cup
release_drop._clear: set down short of a bench or the table edge between him and the Bearer, by this much

attacks._tell: the right fist, a horn frozen in it, drawn back across the body (0.9 s); a heavy backhand, 3.8 m. Parryable.

turns his shoulder; the long table on his back swings round behind it (1.4 s); a fan of 160 degrees glows from 1.8 to 7.5 m; whoever is in it is slid 3 m outward and pinned against a wall or bench (0.9 s, mash). Inside 1.8 m it passes overhead. Phase 3: right round.

wrenches a bench up off the floor with both hands, over his head (1.6 s); a 2.2 m circle glows where the Bearer stands; the bench lands 0.5 s after it leaves his hands, on the circle. Knocks down. Phase 2: a second bench where the Bearer is running to.
both arms out over the table, palms up (1.6 s); with fewer than two guests standing, two more stand up from the benches where they sat (at most three up), and the horns in front of their places fill.

lifts a great horn off the table at his back and tips it out ahead of him (1.2 s); a 1.2 m circle glows where it pours; frost spreads from it across the floor, 1.2 to 6 m over 3 s, and stays 8 s; its edge glows as it spreads; frost bites every half second on it.

the Bearer more than 6 m off: he turns to the table and lifts a horn (1.6 s). No attack: he fills the horns along the table, his back to the Bearer: open. Hits do not stop him. Every guest standing is mended. Left alone 5 s, a guest stands at an empty place and he turns back.

feast_guest_seated.name: Feast-guest
feast_guest_seated.desc: A guest the frost took in its seat at the feast. Both hands have grown into rounded fists of ice.
feast_guest_seated._ai: TARNHALL.md 4, 6. A guest still in its place at the long table (pose sit_feast). It does not stand for the Bearer passing: the Host raises it, or a blow does. Otherwise a Feast-guest.

attacks._tell: right fist swung round flat, shoulder first (0.6 s). Parryable. Often the left after it.
the weight goes over, the left fist low (0.45 s). Only after a Cuff.
both fists lifted together over the head as if raising a horn, breath twice (1.2 s); a 2.2 m circle glows round it; both fists come down on the floor and everything in the circle is hit. Step out.

collier.name: Collier
collier.desc: A charcoal-burner the frost took at the clamps. Both hands have frozen black, with an ember's dark core in each.
collier._ai: THORNWOLD.md 5. Slow. Rakes along the ground, brings both black hands down, and throws frozen coals onto circles round the Bearer.

attacks._tell: both hands drawn back low to one side (0.8 s); a slow sweep along the ground at shin height.
both black hands raised over the head, breath twice (1.2 s); brought down together. Heavy. Not parryable.
crouches and scoops at the ground, the cores in its hands brighten (1.1 s); three small circles glow round the Bearer; the frozen coals land on them.

rime_stag.name: Rime-stag
rime_stag.desc: A red deer the frost took mid-bound. Thorn has grown through its antlers.
rime_stag._ai: THORNWOLD.md 5. Fast. Gores, bounds the length of a strip and comes down at the end, and shakes thorn off its antlers round itself.

attacks._tell: head down, antlers forward, a stamp (0.6 s); a short lunge, 3 m.
rears, forefeet off the ground (0.9 s); a 1.6 x 10 m strip glows; it leaps the length of the strip and comes down at the end. Knocks down.
lowers its head and shakes it, frost spraying off the antlers (0.9 s); a 2.6 m circle glows; thorn rakes everything round it.

hedgelayer.name: The Hedgelayer
hedgelayer.desc: Eyvind Brask, hedge-layer, betrothed to Linnet the collier. He hedged in her grave so nobody could come and sing her out, and never decided where the gate went.
hedgelayer._fight: THORNWOLD.md 6. Phases by HP fraction (phase_at). Each attack lists its phases; by_phase overrides a field per phase; phase_speed scales every timing. Intro: laying a stem until the Bearer is within wake_dist or strikes him. grave_off: [dx, dz] from where he stands to the grave (the rings' centre). ring2/ring3: the phase rings round the grave.

wake._tell: lets the stem go and turns; the briar on his mask moves; the bar appears

p2._tell: drives both hands into the ground: a ring of thorn rises round the grave, 8 m out, its gap where he stands

p3._tell: the ring closes in to 6 m; he stands in its gap

attacks._tell: the bill-arm drawn back across the body (0.8 s); a long cut, 3.2 m. Parryable.
the stems on his right arm unwind and trail on the ground (1.1 s); a 1.2 x 9 m strip glows; the lash catches and drags the Bearer in to 2 m (mash to break), then a Bill. Phase 3: twice.

both hands driven into the ground, the stems on his back stand up (1.4 s); a 1.4 x 9 m strip glows across the floor behind the Bearer; a wall of frozen thorn 3 m high rises along it and stays 14 s. Phase 2: two, a lane either side of him.

walks backward into the nearest thorn, which closes over him (0.9 s); gone; 1.2 s later the stems at another place on the hedge shiver and a 3 m circle glows in front of them (0.8 s); he steps out there with a Bill across the circle.

the Bearer more than 5 m off: he turns to the gap in the ring and holds his hands up either side of it (1.6 s). No attack. He measures the gap, steps to the other side of it, measures it again, his back to the Bearer: open. Hits do not stop him. Left alone 5 s, he turns back.

drover.name: Drover
drover.desc: A herd the frost took on the drift down. A crook of ice has grown from both hands, one piece, and it will not put it down.
drover._ai: REACH.md 5. Long-limbed, keeps a crook's length off. Sweeps the crook, hooks a leg and pulls the Bearer off his feet toward it, and whistles the rams in.

attacks._tell: the crook carried back over the left shoulder, both hands (0.7 s); a long flat sweep, 3 m. Parryable.
the crook turned over, hook down, slid out along the ground (1.0 s); a 1.0 x 5 m strip glows; it takes the Bearer by the leg and pulls him in to 1.5 m (mash to break). Then a Crook sweep.
two fingers to the mask, head back, breath straight up (0.9 s); every idle Frost-ram within 18 m lifts its head and comes. No damage.

frost_ram.name: Frost-ram
frost_ram.desc: A fell tup the frost took with its head down. The horns have gone on growing, in ice, a full turn more than a ram's should.
frost_ram._ai: REACH.md 5. Backs off to charging distance (keep_range), charges the length of a strip, butts whoever is close, and kicks out behind at whoever gets round it.

attacks._tell: a step back, head tucked (0.5 s); a short drive forward, 2.4 m.

head right down, one forefoot scraping twice, breath forward (1.0 s); a 1.5 x 11 m strip glows; it runs the length of the strip. Knocks down. Not blockable. It cannot stop: it overruns and stands shaking its head (1.3 s).
the Bearer behind it: hindquarters drop, a glance back (0.45 s); both hind feet. 2.2 m behind.

fellcaller.name: The Fellcaller
fellcaller.desc: Sigga Calder, whose calls carried three valleys. Her father walked up to the high fold in the night so she would not catch his cough. She has been calling the flock to him ever since.
fellcaller._fight: REACH.md 6. Phases by HP fraction (phase_at). Each attack lists its phases; by_phase overrides a field per phase; phase_speed scales every timing. Intro: calling over the fold wall beside her father until the Bearer is within wake_dist or strikes her. father_off: [dx, dz] from where she stands to where he sits. guard_r: in phase 3 she will not go further than this from him.

wake._tell: the call stops in the middle; she lowers the horn and turns; the bar appears

p2._tell: both arms up, the horn over her head, a call that does not rise (3.0 s); two Frost-rams come over the fold wall

p3._tell: she goes back to her father and stands over him, between him and the Bearer (3.0 s)

attacks._tell: the calling horn drawn back across the body in the right fist (0.8 s); one long backhand, 3.4 m. Parryable.

the horn to the mask, her head goes back, breath straight up (1.5 s); a 6.5 m circle glows round her; the cry goes up and everything in the circle is staggered. Little damage. Roll through the end of it, or be outside. Phase 3: twice.
she drops her head till the ram's horns point at the Bearer and scrapes one foot back (1.1 s); a 1.9 x 13 m strip glows; she runs the length of it. Knocks down. Not blockable. She overruns (1.4 s).

one arm out flat to the side, the horn at her mask, a long level call (1.6 s); a 3.2 x 20 m strip glows across the fold through where the Bearer stands; the flock comes over the wall and down the strip in a rush. Phase 3: a second strip across the first.
two short calls, the horn dipped twice (1.2 s); with fewer than two Frost-rams standing, one more comes over the wall.

the Bearer more than 6 m off: she turns to her father, crouches to his height and calls once, low, the way you call a flock in for somebody else to count (1.6 s). No attack. Her back is to the Bearer: open. Hits do not stop her. Left alone 5 s, she stands and turns back.

upwalker.name: Upwalker
upwalker.desc: One of the dead of the lower steadings, on its way up the water to wait for a spring. It got this far. It is in no hurry, and it does not step aside.
upwalker._ai: COLDWELL.md 5. Slow. Stands in the way with its shoulder turned (block_arc, block_chance): go round it, or wait for it to fall. Shoulders the Bearer back down the path, and falls forward its whole length.

attacks._tell: turns side-on and drops the near shoulder, one slow step (0.9 s); a shove with the whole body. Little damage; it puts the Bearer back 3 m, down the path.

stops, sways back on its heels, breath twice (1.3 s); a 1.4 x 3.6 m strip glows; it goes over on its face like a climber letting go. Heavy. Not blockable. It lies there (2.2 s) before it gets its knees under it: open.

unsung.name: The Unsung
unsung.desc: Someone nobody sang for. The ice has gone clear, and there is very little left in it. Any song breaks it.
unsung._ai: COLDWELL.md 5. Thin and quick, in twos. Reaches with both hands, one after the other, and breathes in close. A Song of any kind breaks it outright (breaks_to).

attacks._tell: the right hand out, palm up, as if to be given something (0.5 s). Parryable. Often the left after it.
the other hand (0.4 s). Only after a Reach.
the mask tips back and it draws a long breath, as before a first note (1.0 s); a 2.4 m circle glows; no note comes: the cold does.

leadvoice.name: The Leadvoice
leadvoice.desc: Maren of Saltfell, who began the Outsong at every burial on the coast. She sits at the wellhead with her youngest against her chest.
leadvoice._fight: COLDWELL.md 6. She has no strike: nothing here opens a hand volume. Phases by HP fraction (phase_at). Phases 1 and 2 she stays sat (seat_clip held at its first frame); in phase 3 she stands, and a blade no longer counts (p3_blade): the Bearer stands within sing_r and sings (verses, verse_time each, broken by a blow). After each verse she bows her head (verse_bow) and the Unsung near are broken.

wake._tell: she lifts her head from the child; the bar appears

p2._tell: her head comes right up and her shoulders with it (2.4 s); two of the Unsung stand up out of the ice

p3._tell: she stands up, for the first time, the cloak tearing out of the ice of the spring (4.0 s)

attacks._tell: her mask comes up off the child and stays up, a thin breath, held (1.4 s); a 1.8 x 12 m strip glows from her toward the Bearer; the air along it freezes and stands, a ridge of rime teeth to the hip, for 9 s. Two blows break it. Phase 2: wider.

the Bearer within reach of the child: she folds herself down over it, both arms round (0.9 s); a 3.8 m circle glows; the cold comes off her back and puts the Bearer out to the edge of it. Hardly any damage.

she draws herself up and the breath goes on and on (2.0 s); a band glows from 4.6 m out to 13 m, all the way round; everything in it is frozen through. Close to her there is nothing: stand inside it. Phase 3: twice.
she breathes in as if to begin, and holds it, and does not begin (1.8 s); with fewer than two of the Unsung standing, two stand up out of the ice between her and the Bearer (at most three).
her head turns to the gap in the stones and stays there (1.6 s); an Upwalker comes in up the river and stands in the way (at most one).
